# torchflow

Normalizing flows in R using the [torch](https://torch.mlverse.org/)
package.

You can install this package from source using the `devtools` package:

`{r} devtools::install_github('mbertolacci/torchflow')`

Go read the vignette on the package website to learn more:
[torchflow](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/).

*More details to come*

# Package index

## All functions

- [`forward_kl_loss()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/forward_kl_loss.md)
  : Forward KL Loss
- [`generate_from_conditional_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/generate_from_conditional_flow.md)
  : Generate samples from a conditional flow model
- [`nn_actnorm_block()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_actnorm_block.md)
  : ActNorm Block
- [`nn_affine_coupling_block()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_affine_coupling_block.md)
  : Affine Coupling Block
- [`nn_affine_coupling_transform()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_affine_coupling_transform.md)
  : Affine Coupling Transform
- [`nn_conditional()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_conditional.md)
  : Conditional Module
- [`nn_conditional_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_conditional_flow.md)
  : Conditional Normalizing Flow
- [`nn_conditional_mlp()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_conditional_mlp.md)
  : Conditional Multilayer Perceptron
- [`nn_coupling_transform()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_coupling_transform.md)
  : Coupling Transform
- [`nn_dual_coupling_block()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_dual_coupling_block.md)
  : Dual Coupling Block
- [`nn_permutation_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_permutation_flow.md)
  : Permutation Flow
- [`nn_sequential_conditional_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_sequential_conditional_flow.md)
  : Sequential Conditional Flow
- [`nn_single_coupling_block()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_single_coupling_block.md)
  : Single Coupling Block
- [`nn_spline_coupling_block()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_spline_coupling_block.md)
  : Spline Coupling Block
- [`nn_spline_coupling_transform()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_spline_coupling_transform.md)
  : Spline Coupling Transform
- [`nn_summarizing_conditional_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/nn_summarizing_conditional_flow.md)
  : Summarizing Conditional Flow
- [`train_conditional_flow()`](https://mbertolacci.github.io/torchflow/reference/train_conditional_flow.md)
  : Train a conditional flow model
